extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors attempting to create or locate an article (new or missing-page troubleshooting)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who encounter a missing-page notice on Wikipedia and need to create, locate, or troubleshoot an article (account requirements, searching existing content, using the article wizard, redirects, deletion checks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly, log in or create an account and obtain autoconfirmed status before attempting to create a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are unable or should not create the article directly, use the article wizard to produce a draft for community review or request that someone create the article for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Joni Mitchell Spotify" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia to avoid duplicating existing coverage under a different title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the desired title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking inbound links can reveal whether content exists under another title or if a redirect should be created.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a page exists but cannot see it, allow time for database updates or use the purge function to refresh the page caching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, when appropriate, create redirects from alternate capitalizations to the canonical article title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect deletion, consult the deletion log to learn the reason and whether restoration or re-creation is appropriate.
